question: Which decisions affect auth/, listed by date, with sources?
raw_answer:
Three architectural decisions affect the auth/ module, listed chronologically:

1. **Token Authentication Architecture** (ADR-0002, 2025-10-15): Established the token-based authentication framework [S1].
2. **Rate limiting architecture decision** (PR #237, 2026-02-10): Decided on per-tenant rate limits, as stated: "We are going with per-tenant rate limits." [S2].
3. **MFA Mandate** (ADR-0008, 2026-03-01): Required multi-factor authentication for all auth/ endpoints [S3].

Context: As of the latest sync (2026-03-01). These decisions are documented in ADRs and a pull request.

Reasoning: These decisions were identified as directly affecting the auth/ module based on their content and implementation details.

Sources:
[S1] ADR-0002 Token Authentication Architecture, 2025-10-15, https://github.com/saksham-AI500/company-brain-synthetic-testbed/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-token-auth.md
[S2] PR #237 Rate limiting architecture decision, 2026-02-10, https://github.com/saksham-AI500/company-brain-synthetic-testbed/pull/237
[S3] ADR-0008 MFA Mandate, 2026-03-01, https://github.com/saksham-AI500/company-brain-synthetic-testbed/blob/main/docs/adr/0008-mfa-mandate.md
